mapper.select: SELECT u.id, u.login_id AS loginId, u.password, u.name, u.role, c.id AS companyNumericId, c.company_id AS companyCode, c.expiration_date AS expirationDate FROM user u INNER JOIN user_company_map ucm ON u.id = ucm.user_id INNER JOIN company c ON ucm.company_id = c.id WHERE u.login_id = #{loginId} AND u.status = 'active' AND UPPER(TRIM(c.company_id)) = #{companyId}
mapper.update: UPDATE user SET last_login = NOW() WHERE id = #{userId}
UPDATE user SET remember_token = #{token}, remember_token_expires = DATE_ADD(NOW(), INTERVAL 30 DAY) WHERE id = #{userId}
mapper.select: SELECT secondary_password FROM user WHERE id = #{userId}
